title: Satoshi Has No Clothes: Failures in On-Chain Privacy by Ian Miers (Devcon4)
summary: Ian Miers' Devcon4 talk on failures in on-chain privacy for Bitcoin and Ethereum. It covers attacks on transparent and decoy-based schemes, including how Monero-style privacy can be eroded over repeated transactions.
why: HN cites it in Monero and Zcash debates as a critique of decoy-based privacy and its passive and active attacks.

quote.text: core argument starts at around 10 minutes.
